arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Beeson argued the law creates compelled speech concerns. She noted many web operators are single individuals.
General Olson argued the government has a responsibility to protect children. He cited the Ginsberg case for this principle.
General Olson stated all three branches of government support this view. He claimed pornography is widely available to children online.
